description: This file is a Python script that implements a linter for checking consistency of jobs across GitHub workflows, focusing on 'sync-tag' matching.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration for severity levels of lint messages.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a lint message with details such as path, line, code, severity, and description.

methods.name: glob_yamls
methods.description: Generates all YAML files (*.yml, *.yaml) in a given directory path.

methods.name: load_yaml
methods.description: Loads a YAML file from a given path.

methods.name: is_workflow
methods.description: Checks if a loaded YAML object represents a GitHub workflow (contains 'jobs').

methods.name: print_lint_message
methods.description: Prints a JSON-formatted lint message indicating a workflow inconsistency.

methods.name: get_jobs_with_sync_tag
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes job information with 'sync-tag' from a job dictionary.
